investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare personnel with elevated privileges for PHI/EMR access, production AWS resources, and payroll/PII are listed in an external Scribd document. The document exposes names, emails, and sensitive access details, creating a data leakage risk if publicly accessible. This exposure could enable credential misuse or targeted phishing and warrants escalation.
